diagnosis.detail: The refresh test required the original golden paragraph/cache metadata after deliberately supplying new citation text. Newmain moves unchanged golden validation into the nonmutating save/reopen test and removes the contradictory refresh call. Existing refreshed text, item metadata, note indices, boundary/code properties and italic/bold checks remain.

_readRPr removes rPrChange into document revision metadata. Previously the boundary retained only stripped rPr XML; the new native classifier could consider that local packet editable although document-wide revision guards still refused it. Boundary-only revision records also retain incomplete/ambiguous-target export refusal. Newmain reconstructs the boundary source rPr including rPrChange, so local field classification remains opaque and the source metadata survives import.

incomingSafeguardsReviewed: Complete-element XML validation rejects multiple roots, nonwhitespace prefix/suffix text, PI/DTD, duplicate attributes and truncated fragments; existing XmlPullReader verifies matching end tags.
Empty code runs with modeled style references or pending imported empty-run revision provenance are refused.

hasEmptyFormattingRevision follows property copies, style resolution and coalescing comparisons. Acceptance clears the empty-run provenance; rejection restores ordinary source properties through the existing revision path.
New tests cover empty-run history retention, native/direct edit refusal, acceptance/rejection and copied undo restoration.

recommendation.reason: The visible-result helper and its nine regressions address a separate code-style fallback leak. Incoming changes strengthen classification/revision ownership without changing that fix.
recommendation.postRefreshOracleNote: Adopted the shared helper with explicit constant FIRST1→Refreshed first and SECOND2→Refreshed second expected deltas. Original golden bytes, full layout/color/preferences/story/item metadata checks, boundary/code source checks and new-cache styling checks remain enforced after Refresh and across three save/reopen cycles.

limits: The complete reconciled boundary suite was run on the pinned Dart runtime. Broader selected engine/editor coverage remains separately owned by root.
Preserving boundary rPrChange does not claim editable or freely re-exportable unsupported boundary revisions; existing document revision save guards remain active.
Broader reconciled engine/editor qualification belongs to root.

targetedRequalification.sourceIdentification: The recorded HEAD is context for a working merge plus test edits. Accepted input hashes identify the tested files; root will checkpoint and run the broader qualified source snapshot.
